Cypress Grove Chevre # 213146 7oz (random weight) Cypress Grove Chevre # 35363 5oz (random weight) Products are random (various) weight. The 7 oz is packed 6 packs per case. products.reason_for_recall: DPI Specialty Foods has been notified that some Cypress Grove Humboldt Fog Goat Cheese was labeled with incorrect ingredients. This product is produced with pasteurized goat milk, and was labeled as containing cultured raw cow's milk.
